CLOUD DESIGN-REVISION seat for tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, topic design-r10-arch-docs-first. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: revise the design note dev/programme/designs/R10-ARCH-DOCS-FIRST.md (group R10-ARCH-DOCS-FIRST: the CI and development-shape docs and figures for the PROTECTED FINAL SHAPE AT PROGRAMME END). Its current version is at refs/heads/design/r10-arch-docs-first, 16954f0c8e7243004a6adcf69c9f28acbca23607. The design review returned REVISE, architecture-unsound. Read the verdict with `git fetch origin handoff-body/design-verdict-r10-arch-docs-first && git show FETCH_HEAD:BODY.md`. Main is now 0b162da1adb73367eddcae1623cf5688422ad9a7; #2600 landed the R10-ARCH-DOCS-FIRST roster group there.
Required:
- Fix all three revise points exactly as the verdict asks:
  1. Drop predicate (c) from this group's checker, or make it report-only. It must never refuse. "No target marker names a done group" moves to R10-ARCH-DOCS's end-of-round predicate.
  2. Every predicate holds both before and after the named group lands. (a) exempts `retired-by` paths too. State this invariant beside the grammar.
  3. Make the work order audit -> [design -> design review, L/XL] -> fix -> fix review -> train -> merge -> record -> stamp, per R10-FLOW-DESIGN-POLICY (now in dev/governance/roles/) and ORCHESTRATOR-PROMPT (origin/claude/dazzling-gauss-7l3u2b:dev/programme/flow-study/ORCHESTRATOR-PROMPT.md, line 51, R16-R19). Apply the same in §4's handoff path.
- Fold in observations C1-C9 and C11.
- C10 is the orchestrator's decision: the extra hot files (dev/README.md, tests/doc_claims.py, tests/layout.json, tests/closure.py, tests/closures.json, tools/site/build_docs.mjs) are listed in the fixer's PR body. List them in the note under Hot files.
- Keep every carry line already in the note, unless the verdict supersedes it.
- Push the revised note as ONE new commit on refs/heads/design/r10-arch-docs-first, parent 16954f0c8e7243004a6adcf69c9f28acbca23607, a fast-forward. Rebasing onto main is unnecessary.
- Add a short "Revision 2" section at the top mapping each revise point and C-item to the change.
- Time box 45 min.
Return: bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh design-r10-arch-docs-first-r2 <result.md>, holding the new design SHA and one line per revise point and per C-item.
Do not write production docs or open a PR. Every observation carries 'Carry: <GROUP>' or 'Carry: dismissed <reason of 2+ words>'. Spare the GitHub API. Never write to any ref except the design ref and your handoff-body return ref.
